# FG-REVIEW-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_merge_identity_with_a_bad_email_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: アカウントのメールアドレスがコミットの作成者として使えない形式です。管理者にメールアドレスの修正を依頼してから、もう一度マージしてください。
- en: The account's e-mail address cannot be used as a commit author. Ask the administrator to fix the e-mail address, then merge again.
- id: Alamat e-mail akun tidak dapat digunakan sebagai penulis commit. Minta administrator memperbaiki alamat e-mail, lalu merge lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

The merge job builds the merge or squash commit's author and committer from the database (ADR-0024 §4.1) and an account's e-mail is one git would misread: it holds a control character (newline, NUL), `<` or `>`, or nothing but git's end "crud" (blanks, `.` `,` `:` `;` `"` `\` `'`). Display names are normalised instead (those characters dropped; a name with nothing left falls back to the username), so only the e-mail is refused. The attempt was set to `superseded`; no commit was written and no ref moved.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The job's `forge.review.merge_completed outcome=superseded error_code=FG-REVIEW-0012` carries `field=email` (or `name` when even the username leaves nothing), `rule=control_character|angle_bracket|empty` and `user_id`; the value is never logged. Read the account (read-only): SELECT id, username, email FROM forge.users WHERE id = <user_id>; the merge's author is the requester (and, for a squash, the merge request's author).

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the account's e-mail (the identity provider's attribute, then a new sign-in, or the administrator's account tools) and merge again.
